visual_action: The video is a montage of scenes featuring ICE (Immigration and Customs Enforcement) agents and police officers in various settings. Scene 1: Inside an airport/terminal, a Black male ICE agent wearing a tactical vest labeled "POLICE ICE" interacts with a woman in a high-visibility safety vest pushing a cart of water bottles; other travelers are visible. Scene 2: A Black man in a red hoodie, baseball cap, glasses, and backpack stands in what appears to be an airport terminal, holding documents and luggage, while a hand extends a water bottle toward him. Scene 3: Outside an airport passenger drop-off area (sign reads "2A Passenger Drop-Off"), a tactical officer in a vest hands a water bottle to a young boy; a woman and young girl are nearby, and a cooler is visible. Scene 4: Outside an airport terminal, a tactical officer wearing a vest labeled "POLICE" directs people near traffic cones and caution tape. Scene 5: A dramatic low-light/cinematic shot of ICE/Police tactical officers from behind, walking in formation, with "POLICE" labels visible on vests. Scene 6: A heavily armored tactical officer in full gear (helmet with red visor, body armor labeled "FEDERAL AGENT") shining a bright flashlight toward the camera at night. Scene 7: A masked, helmeted tactical officer in full tactical gear walking through smoke or fog toward the camera at night, with other officers flanking. Scene 8: A bald, muscular ICE/tactical officer in a tactical vest hands water bottles to someone off-camera in an indoor setting. Throughout, the recurring subtitle "ICE is all we need." appears at the bottom of every frame.
